dogecoin.text:
$DOGE is reversing after hitting an 8-month resistance from Oct 2024. 

A break above the $0.168 rectangle pattern could be bullish, especially if sentiment stays positive. 

This zone may offer a good accumulation point.
#Dogecoin 🚀 https://t.co/lCVK5MDOar

#Bittensor targets two trillion-dollar markets:

AI: Projected to hit $2T by 2030
ML: Estimated $200B by 2029

Lee believes this could push $TAO's market cap to ~$44.5B, still under Dogecoin’s $80B ATH.
 With low supply and AI hype, it’s not far-fetched.

Critics say Ondo’s market cap is too big  but compared to coins like Dogecoin at its peak, it’s modest.

 A $20 Ondo would put its market cap around $63B, which is still lower than DOGE’s  2021 high.

 With over 600M crypto users today, that doesn’t seem far-fetched.
